newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 10 killed in Colombian fighting.
newsitem.headline: At least 10 killed in Colombian fighting.

text.p: At least 10 people died in fighting involving Colombia's army, leftist insurgents and a right-wing paramilitary group in the northwest of the country Thursday and early Friday, authorities said.
Military spokesmen said troops fought into the early hours of Friday with members of the leftist Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia, the country's largest rebel group.

They said one soldier was killed in the fighting and five civilians died when their hamlet on the outskirts of the town of Turbo was caught in crossfire. Turbo is in the heart of the banana-growing region of Uraba in northwest Antioquia province.
Four members of another leftist group, the National Liberation Army, died in a separate clash with a right-wing paramilitary group on the outskirts of the city of Remedios, also in Antioquia.
